beliefs: The box strips trailing whitespace (including Unicode whitespace like NBSP and em-space) and then uppercases the first character using full .upper() semantics, keeping the rest unchanged [E1, E2, E3, E5, E6]
Leading whitespace is preserved, so '  hello' stays '  hello' and ' hello world ' stays ' hello world ' [E2]
Trailing whitespace is stripped, so 'hello  ' becomes 'Hello', 'x   ' becomes 'X', and 'hello\u00a0' becomes 'Hello' [E2, E5]
A lone space or all-space string becomes empty, consistent with trailing-strip leaving nothing [E1, E2]
A tab or newline at position 0 is not uppercased and is preserved, so '\thello' stays '\thello' [E2, E3]
Digits, symbols, and already-uppercase letters are unchanged [E1, E4]
Uppercasing uses full .upper() semantics on the first character, so 'ß'→'Ss', 'ǆ'→'ǅ', 'ﬁ'→'Fi', 'ﬃ'→'Ffix', 'ŉ'→'ʼN' (the full expansion replaces the first char) [E6]
Only the first character is uppercased (with its full expansion); the rest of the string is left untouched, so 'ÉCOLE'→'École' and 'straße'→'Straße' [E5]
